title: Brand identity
blurb: Logo and brand guide: a third revision round, social templates, business cards agreed with a price.
contract: Project: logo and brand guide for Quillon Pottery (a small ceramics studio). Deliverables: logo design (3 initial concepts), then a PDF brand guide (colours with hex codes, fonts, logo usage rules). Fixed fee: $2,400. Includes two rounds of revisions on the chosen concept. Excludes: social media templates, stationery and print design, website.
thread:
Lena: Hi Odette, concept 2 with your feedback is attached (revision round 1)
Odette: love the direction! can the clay colour be slightly darker?
Lena: Sure, that's within round 1. Updated file attached
Odette: yes!! this is it. one tiny thing, the font in the tagline feels thin, can u try a bolder one
Lena: Done, that's round 2 😊 final logo attached
Odette: ok hmm now that i see it, can we try the logo a little more rounded? like a third round?
Lena: Both included rounds are used now. A third round would be extra, I can quote it
Odette: ok let me see
Odette: also could you make some instagram post templates in the same style? like 5 of them
Lena: Social templates aren't part of this package, happy to quote
Odette: ok thanks
Odette: and business cards!! we need them for the market in 2 weeks
Lena: Business cards are extra: $350 for the design + print-ready files. Want me to go ahead?
Odette: yes please, $350 is fine, go ahead
Odette: can the brand guide PDF include the exact hex codes of the colours?
Lena: Of course, that's part of the guide, it'll be in there
Odette: 👍 thx
